Done — one execution, first-try success.

**Approach:** plain `torch` + `safetensors` script at `out/T2/solution.py`. I deliberately skipped `transformers.prune_heads` (the "expected" condition-F route): it operates on an instantiated `GPT2Model`, rewrites the `Conv1D` modules and records `pruned_heads` in the config, which risks changing the key set (the `attn.bias` mask buffers) — grading wants exactly the original 160 keys, bit-exact. `mergekit`/`peft` can't express intra-tensor head slicing.

**The edit** — head 5 removed from every layer, respecting Conv1D `[in, out]`:
- `c_attn.weight`: columns dropped at 320–383, 1088–1151, 1856–1919 (once per q|k|v segment) → `[768, 2112]`
- `c_attn.bias`: same offsets → `[2112]`
- `c_proj.weight`: rows 320–383 dropped → `[704, 768]`
- `attn.c_proj.bias`, `attn.bias`, and `mlp.c_proj.weight` untouched.

**Checks (all pre-write, `AssertionError` aborts before any file is written):** per-layer shapes on all 36 edited tensors plus the three untouched attention/MLP tensors, the four required checks, identical key set and dtypes, and boundary spot-checks that kept column 320 is source column 384. After writing, the file is reloaded and the required checks re-run.

**Independent verification** (outside the artifact): every edited tensor rebuilt via `torch.cat` of the literal ranges in TASK.md matches bit-exactly, and the other 124 tensors are bit-identical to the input.

`out/T2/REPORT.md` is written with the self-report fields.
